question: Should schema-v6 Release Ledger evidence become a mandatory prerequisite enforced by the authoritative release publication workflow?
rationale: The missing invocation is mechanically repairable, but making this new evidence contract mandatory changes release operations and requires release-owner intent.

options.title: Require ledger before publish
options.body: Block publication unless the exact Release Ledger run and artifact validate against the release inputs.

options.title: Keep ledger advisory
options.body: Retain ledger generation and manual validation without making publication depend on it.

recommendation.title: Require ledger before publish
recommendation.body: Block publication unless the exact Release Ledger run and artifact validate against the release inputs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this person directly to immutable validation evidence in the authoritative publication workflow.
